body: - ## G-Py-11: bare `# noqa: E402` suppressions lack inline reasons
- The diff introduces two new import suppressions at lines 9-10 of the changed hunk:
- from larch.core import proc  # noqa: E402
- from larch.git import gh  # noqa: E402

- G-Py-11 requires `# noqa: CODE - reason` (or equivalent). Both suppressions omit the reason. The correct reason is available in context (imports appear after the `sys.path` manipulation block that guards the plugin-root path insertion), so the right form would be:
- from larch.core import proc  # noqa: E402 - after sys.path manipulation
- from larch.git import gh  # noqa: E402 - after sys.path manipulation

- The existing `from larch.issue.analyze_issues import (  # noqa: E402` line (unchanged by this diff) has the same omission, but G-Py-11 applies to changed code; the new lines extend the bare-suppression pattern instead of correcting it.

- No other guidelines are implicated. The removal of `_run_gh_json` in favour of `gh.issue_view_field_read(proc, ...)` is a positive move toward G-Py-7 (typed wrapper over an injected Runner, using the `_read` variant for a parser that needs the raw `CommandResult`). The inlined `except json.JSONDecodeError` is narrowly scoped per G-Py-4. The `payload: object = json.loads(result.stdout)` annotation is a deliberate narrowing of the `Any` return from `json.loads`, consistent with G-Py-9. The `proc` parameter introduces an injectable seam per G-Py-5.
